name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Revenue & Marketing Operations Leader
summary: Revenue and marketing operations leader with 15+ years building the GTM systems, CRM architecture, and automation infrastructure that let growth-stage companies scale without adding headcount. Built and deployed 20+ GoHighLevel automation workflows and an AI-driven prospect-audit system that enrolled 180+ contacts; at Wix, supported an e-commerce portfolio that grew website traffic 30% and conversion rates 25%. Hands-on across HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, and the broader martech stack, translating ambiguous business goals into CRM architecture and reporting frameworks non-technical teams can run.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architect end-to-end GTM systems for B2B service clients — CRM architecture, lifecycle stage design, lead scoring/routing, and HubSpot/GoHighLevel-Salesforce integration — replacing manual processes with infrastructure that scales without added headcount.

Architected and deployed 20+ GoHighLevel automation workflows spanning lead capture/routing, qualification, appointment booking, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, reactivation, and review generation.

Designed an AI-driven prospect-audit workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts, scoring each business's digital footprint to trigger personalized outreach; translate non-technical stakeholder intent into precise agent prompts and logic.

Deliver executive-facing revenue dashboards and attribution reporting (GA4 + CRM analytics) giving founders first-time visibility into pipeline performance and campaign ROI, while owning discovery/onboarding for the client portfolio.

bullets: Managed integrated digital marketing campaigns across SEO, paid media, and content, coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure consistent execution.
Built campaign reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, translating results into optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Produced landing pages, email sequences, and conversion-focused copy supporting lead generation and pipeline.
